readout_other: Y-maze spontaneous alternation; novel object recognition; Congo red amyloid plaque counts; H&E
direction_notes: Weekly hippocampal tUS preserved spatial and recognition memory and reduced amyloid plaque density by more than 40% versus sham in 5xFAD mice.
safety_notes: H&E and VAF staining showed no structural abnormalities, damage or ischemic injury; vital signs monitored during sonication.

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed, 75 ms pulse duration, 2 Hz PRF, 30 minutes per session under isoflurane, weekly for 15 weeks from 11 weeks of age; sham group had zero acoustic output.

source_quotes.n_subjects: After an acclimation period of at least three days upon arrival, the mice were randomly assigned to either the group that receive sonication (tUS+) or the one that receives sham tUS (tUS-, n= 6 each group).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Weekly tUS sessions continued until 6 months of age (15 sessions total)

flags.reason: 12 mice total, 6 per group; only the 6 in the tUS+ group were sonicated.
Behavioural and histology raters were blinded to condition; sonication itself could not be blinded as far as stated.
770 kPa is the maximum rarefactional pressure; field mapped in degassed water tank.
Intensities stated without explicit domain; assigned to free field because the pressure field was calibrated in a degassed water tank.
Duty cycle of 15% stated as 'Considering 15% duty cycle'; 75 ms x 2 Hz agrees.
